scope_note: Technical ATS/career-inventory mapping only; this file does not contain vacancy screening results.

verification_levels.FULL: Complete official public inventory can be enumerated and completeness can be demonstrated.
verification_levels.STRONG: Official inventory is strong and near-complete, but a small technical limitation prevents a strict completeness guarantee.
verification_levels.PARTIAL: Official jobs can be checked reliably, but the full inventory cannot be proven complete.
verification_levels.OPAQUE: Official system is too closed, authenticated, anti-bot, or technically opaque for reliable verification.

verification.pagination: Workday CXS limit/offset; exact total reconciliation required

External job boards may index earlier or later than Workday and are used only as a discovery layer.
